data.one_liner: Generate random alphanumeric strings and unique nonces in Dart.
data.what_it_does: Nonce provides a static generator and object constructors to create random alphanumeric strings directly from ASCII character codes. It supports default, unique, and secure random variations.
use_when: You need to generate random alphanumeric strings or nonces.
You require unique nonces tracked globally during execution.
You need secure random string generation.
avoid_when: You need advanced cryptographic primitives or hashing functions provided by other packages.
You need universally unique identifiers (UUIDs) specifically.
strengths: Generates ASCII character codes directly without Base64 encoding overhead.
Supports unique nonce tracking out of the box.
weaknesses: Limited functionality beyond random string and nonce generation.

alternatives.name: uuid
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you specifically need standard UUIDs (v1, v4, v5) instead of generic alphanumeric nonces.

alternatives.name: crypto
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need cryptographic hash functions, digests, or encryption algorithms.
